W.note: Pill collapses nicely with dismiss and status announcements, but the ETA is truncated when collapsed and the opened header row has an overlapping, cramped tracking-number line.

X.note: Very small collapsed bar with progress strip and a polished opened timeline with ETA, carrier and tracking tail, though it lacks a live region and a clear next-action line and adds an unneeded package select.

Y.note: Clean teal-on-dark with progress bar, step count, ETA time and right-aligned timestamps, but empty padding at the bottom when opened and no tracking number or carrier shown.

Z.note: Covers status, carrier link, number, timeline and a no-action note in a tight panel, but the collapsed ETA is truncated and the footer buttons wrap awkwardly.
